name: Durango

standard.note: Durango's plate is white with green lettering, a 'DGO.' logo up top and a bright strip of flowers along the bottom under the word DURANGO.

plates.title: Current design (2023)
plates.fact: Durango's plate is white with green lettering, a 'DGO.' logo up top and a bright strip of flowers along the bottom under the word DURANGO.

notes: The replaqueo for this design ran in 2023 (announced Oct 2022, El Siglo de Torreón). In June 2026 Gov. Esteban Villegas gave owners who hadn't replated 15 days to get current plates, waiving surcharges (posta.com.mx, 16 Jun 2026), so older plates are not considered valid. The design description is from news thumbnails and sdpnoticias. I found no official government picture: durango.gob.mx and pagos.durango.gob.mx (the 'Replaqueo' page) have no plate images. Durango charges different fees for hybrid and electric vehicles, but I found no separate plate design for them.
